parameters.name: MatchType
parameters.description:
The query type for the host record of Layer 4 applications. The following four types are supported, and the default is exact match.

- fuzzy: Fuzzy match.
- exact: Exact match.
- prefix: Prefix match.
- suffix: Suffix match.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1-500.

parameters.name: RecordName
parameters.description: The host record of the Layer 4 application.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID. You can obtain it by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.
